# Post hoc agreement ranges of SS (descriptive; generated by agreement_windows.py)

Rule, identical for every film: one-decade windows in 0.25-decade steps, upper edge <= 1e-9 A/um; agreeing if |SS_TCAD - SS_meas| <= 5 mV/dec; the longest contiguous run gives the range (ties: more measured points, then lower current). Measured curve raw (windows from 10 x floor) or with the floor subtracted (windows from 1 x floor; assumes an additive, gate-independent floor). Chosen after seeing the data: describes where the model agrees; not a test and not the reported SS.
